mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the copied chromosomes before dividing the cell was worthwhile: the planned cutaways distinguish two nuclei in one cell from two separate daughter cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The growth passage was less engaging than the division sequence; it assembled several growth processes at once without much further explanation.

surprise.text: The spindle step produced two nuclei while leaving the cytoplasm and outer membrane shared, clarifying that chromosome separation and cell division are distinct.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: the item pictures and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the sequential constructions made the distinction between copying DNA, separating chromosomes and dividing the cell worth following.
